desc: Ideation: identify monotonicity (value nonincreasing in each index when arrays sorted descending) and choose best-first heap selection exploiting K ≤ 5×10⁵
Implement best-first heap solution with encoded visited set and fast I/O; hand-verify on samples 1 and 2
Stress-test against brute force for small N (random inputs, duplicates, N=1, K=N³) to confirm tie handling and correctness
Confirm performance: O(K log K) time, O(K) memory for N=2×10⁵, K=5×10⁵; finalize code with sys.stdin.buffer I/O
